data.title: Indonesia's main airport suspends flights as Krakatoa erupts
data.description: JAKARTA - Indonesia halted operations at its main international airport outside Jakarta on Sunday after ash spewed from the Anak Krakatoa volcano more than 150 kilometres away, impacting thousands of passengers.

data.title: Tourists cheat death on winding downhill road
data.description: PHETCHABUN - Four tourists were lucky to survive a downhill car crash on Phu Thap Boek mountain in Lom Kao district on Sunday, saved by a concrete guardrail from plummeting into the valley below

data.title: Ancient rock paintings discovered in Nong Bua Lamphu cave
data.description: NONG BUA LAMPHU - Fine Arts officials have inspected newly found rock paintings believed to be around 4,000 years old in a cave behind a forest monastery in Na Wang district of this northeastern province, in what archaeologists say could be an important addition to Thailand's prehistoric heritage.

data.title: US aircraft carrier departs Thailand after port call
data.description: LAEM CHABANG (THAILAND) - Thousands of US sailors aboard an aircraft carrier departed from Thailand on Sunday, AFP journalists said, concluding its first port call following reports of deteriorating living conditions on board after nine months at sea.

data.title: Zheng stuns Keys as US Open upsets dim American hopes
data.description: NEW YORK - Zheng Qinwen won the last seven games to stun Madison Keys and reach the US Open last 16 on a Saturday of upsets that dented American hopes at Flushing Meadows.

data.title: China's memories of Mao fade to nostalgia 50 years after his death
data.description: NANJIE (CHINA) - The crimson flags on Nanjie village's "East is Red" Square hang limp in the sweltering summer heat as a trickle of tourists take photos with a towering statue of Chairman Mao Zedong, still gleaming white almost 50 years after he died.

data.title: Opal ends Miss World reign in SIRIVANNAVARI silk gown
data.description: Opal Suchata gave her farewell speech and crowned her successor at the 73rd Miss World Grand Final in Nha Trang, Vietnam, on September 5, 2026.

data.title: Heavy rain in Northeast, later in Greater Bangkok and other regions
data.description: Heavy rain is forecast in the Northeast early this week and then in Greater Bangkok and other regions until Friday.

data.title: British-Nigerian influencer died after penile filler procedure in Thailand
data.description: A Nigerian associate of Afrobeats star Davido has died after suffering a fatal medical complication following a cosmetic penile enlargement procedure in Bangkok.

data.title: Thai khon production based on the Ramayana story of Sita returns in 2026
data.description: The 2026 SUPPORT Foundation production follows Sida from birth to her fire ordeal and the story of her two sons. It runs from Thursday (November 5, 2026) to Thursday (December 10, 2026).

data.title: US envoys discuss 'substantive' plan with Putin towards ending Ukraine war
data.description: KYIV - American envoys discussed "substantive plan" for next steps to end the Ukraine war during their meeting with Russian President Vladimir Putin, the White House said, before they headed to Kyiv on Sunday.

data.title: Thailand urged to turn herbs into high-value health products
data.description: Thailand’s trade policy office proposes four priorities, including clinical testing of herbal extracts, to move agriculture beyond price competition.

data.title: B6m car plunges into canal
data.description: SAMUT PRAKAN - A Porsche Cayenne worth about 6 million baht plunged into a canal in Bang Phli district, after the owner reportedly forgot to engage the parking brake.

data.title: 'The flood is coming': How a Nepal principal saved 900 students
data.description: NUWAKOT (NEPAL) - Rajendra Dawadi was inside his school near Nepal's Trishuli River with around 900 students last week when a colleague delivered an urgent warning.

data.description: The music video surpassed 70.8 million views in its first 24 hours, while its Bangkok locations, Thai cultural elements and tuk-tuks reached a global audience.

data.title: Newcomers Pattani hold giants Pathum as T1 season kicks off
data.description: Coach Vladimir Vujovic conceded that BG Pathum United created several openings but had to settle for a point after being held 0-0 by newly promoted Pattani FC in the opening match of the Thai League 1 season on Friday night.

data.title: Army seeks volunteers
data.description: The army has opened recruitment for "Volunteer Soldiers" next year, offering 18,784 positions nationwide over four‑year contracts with benefits and career opportunities.

data.title: Argentina threatens to sanction oil projects around Falklands
data.description: BUENOS AIRES (ARGENTINA) - Argentina has announced that it will investigate and sanction oil companies working near the Falkland Islands without authorization, after President Javier Milei said the "winds of change" favor his country's claim to the archipelago.

data.title: Their Majesties, Thai government offer relief to Nepal
data.description: <p>Their Majesties the King and Queen graciously commanded Air Chief Marshal Jom Rungsawang, Privy Councillor, to present royal relief items to Dhan Bahadur Oli, Ambassador of Nepal to Thailand, at the aircraft hangar, 601 Squadron, Wing 6, Royal Thai Air Force Base, says the Bureau of the Royal Household yesterday.</p>

data.title: App-based taxi regs on way
data.description: The government is moving to regulate app‑based taxi drivers, with a deadline set for public driver's licence compliance by Sept 30, said deputy government spokeswoman Ploytalay Laksmeesangchan.

data.title: PM seeks proof of exam fraud
data.description: <p>Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has challenged anyone with evidence implicating government members in the local government recruitment examination fraud scheme to submit it to the National Anti-Corruption Commission (NACC), insisting that anyone found guilty will face action regardless of rank.</p>

data.title: Two dive boats seized over coral threat off Phuket
data.description: <p>PHUKET: Natural Resources and Environment Minister Suchart Chomklin has ordered marine authorities to step up enforcement after two diving boats were found moored for several days in waters off Racha Yai Island, in violation of measures designed to protect coral reefs.</p>

data.title: Flash floods hit Phrao after heavy rain
data.description: <p>Heavy rain caused flash floods in Phrao district, Chiang Mai, on Friday night, sending rescue teams to deploy water pumps and move residents' belongings to higher ground.</p>

data.title: Four bodies found in search of unlicensed Jewish cemetery
data.description: <p>Four bodies have been found at a Jewish cemetery in Chachoengsao after more than 40 officials inspected the site, amid concerns three may have been buried after its permit expired.</p>

data.title: Covid-19 wave expected to ease next month

data.title: 'Are we ready?' Oasis film captures band's frosty reunion
data.description: VENICE - A new film about Oasis's historic 2025 world tour, premiering Saturday in Venice, captures the frosty reunion of the British band's Gallagher brothers -- and shows how their children have become the "cement" in their volatile relationship.

data.title: Professors urge quake safeguards
data.description: <p>Thammasat University academics have called for greater resilience and better disaster response as earthquake and climate risks rise.</p>

data.title: Co-payment  scheme in final stretch
data.description: <p>The government has urged beneficiaries of the "Thais Help Thais Plus" co-payment scheme to use their remaining entitlements before the programme ends, as cumulative spending has surged to more than 138 billion baht and generated income for nearly 1.2 million participating businesses.</p>

data.title: New water treatment model helps  700 families after Kok metal scare
data.description: <p>A science-based water treatment project is helping communities along Chiang Rai's Kok River cope with heavy-metal contamination.</p>

data.title: Anutin shrugs off debate threats
data.description: <p>Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has dismissed concerns that opposition MPs will use the upcoming budget debate to attack the government, saying parliamentary scrutiny is part of MPs' rights and responsibilities.</p>

data.title: US carrier visit highlights security ties
data.description: <p>The arrival of the USS Abraham Lincoln aircraft carrier and more than 5,000 US personnel in Pattaya highlights both the strengthening of Thai-US security ties and complex geopolitical dynamics in the region, according to experts.</p>
